import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64,json
lane=Path.cwd()
for page in [9,17]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1400','-singlefile','-png','sources/promotion.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 b64=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode();w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'figures/promotion-p'+str(page)+'.png','--base64'],input=b64,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('IMAGE '+b64)
